questions.question: What function does water have when you flush the toilet?
What function does water have when you dissolve sugar in tea?
What is surface water?

answers.d: Water in rivers, lakes and oceans

questions.question: What is groundwater?
Which water usually contains less pollution?
What is water without dissolved substances called?
Which water contains the highest concentration of salts?
What is the density of seawater? (use BINAS table 16)
Seawater contains a lot of table salt (sodium chloride, Na<sup>+</sup> and Cl<sup>-</sup>). Is table salt very soluble, slightly soluble or insoluble in water? (use BINAS table 35)
Less water is flowing in a river. The amount of pollution stays the same. What happens to the concentration of pollution?
What does disinfecting mean?
How can you disinfect something?

answers.b: By heating or with a disinfectant

questions.question: What function does water have when it keeps an engine or a factory cool?
What is a coolant?

answers.a: A substance that rinses things clean
answers.b: A substance in which other substances dissolve
answers.c: A substance that absorbs heat and carries it away
answers.d: A substance that speeds up a reaction

questions.question: Why is water so suitable as a coolant?

answers.d: Water can absorb a lot of heat and is cheap and widely available

questions.question: What is industrial water?

answers.a: Water that factories use, for example for cooling or cleaning
answers.c: Water that is only used in the home
answers.d: Tap water that you are allowed to drink

questions.question: What function does water have when you cook pasta?
What function does water have when you rinse dirty pans?
What is a solvent?

answers.a: A substance that stops a reaction
answers.b: A substance that is always a solid
answers.c: A substance that only carries away heat
answers.d: A substance in which you can dissolve another substance

questions.question: What is a solution?

answers.a: A cloudy mixture of two liquids
answers.b: A pure substance without dissolved parts
answers.c: A clear mixture of a dissolved substance in a solvent

questions.question: You dissolve salt in water. What is the solute and what is the solvent?

answers.a: Water is the solute, salt is the solvent
answers.d: Salt is the solute, water is the solvent

questions.question: From which two kinds of water does a drinking-water company in the Netherlands mainly make drinking water?
Why does surface water have to be purified before you can drink it?

answers.c: It contains dirt, bacteria and dissolved substances

questions.question: What is the first step in purifying surface water?

answers.a: Removing coarse dirt with grids and sieves

questions.question: What does a drinking-water company use a sand filter for?

answers.b: To remove salt from the water
answers.c: To filter small solid particles out of the water

questions.question: What is the filtrate when you let water run through a sand filter?

answers.c: The dirt that stays behind in the filter
answers.d: The water that passes through the filter

questions.question: What is activated carbon used for in the purification of water?

answers.a: It makes the water softer by evaporation
answers.c: Odour and flavour substances stay attached to the carbon (adsorption)

questions.question: On which property is adsorption with activated carbon based?

answers.a: Ability to attach to a surface

questions.question: Why is drinking water disinfected?

answers.d: To make bacteria and other pathogens harmless

questions.question: How can you make drinking water from seawater?

answers.a: By filtering through a sand filter
answers.d: By distilling: the water evaporates and the salt stays behind

questions.question: What is the distillate when you distil seawater?

answers.a: A mixture of water and sand

questions.question: How can you get salt out of seawater?
Why is seawater not suitable for drinking?

answers.c: It contains too many dissolved salts

questions.question: Why is a factory not allowed to simply discharge waste water into a river?

answers.a: Waste water is always drinking water
answers.b: The waste water pollutes the surface water

questions.question: What happens to waste water in a sewage treatment plant?

answers.a: It is pumped into the ground without being treated
answers.b: It is purified before it goes back into the surface water
answers.d: It is sold directly as drinking water
